question: Should this report be transferred to openclaw/openclaw, or closed here with instructions to open a fully diagnosed OpenClaw provider issue?
rationale: The problem is clearly outside Graincrawl’s code boundary, but this repository’s conservative cleanup policy requires the assigned owner to choose the cross-repository routing action.

options.title: Transfer to OpenClaw core
options.body: Move the issue to openclaw/openclaw and request current versions, redacted effective configuration, model status, and failure output there.

options.title: Redirect with diagnostics
options.body: Close this repository item only after giving the reporter exact OpenClaw diagnostic requirements and asking for a new core issue.
